gold_sql:
WITH p1 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.967704 41.049287)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.967704 41.049287)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
),
p2 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-90.031353 35.139317)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-90.031353 35.139317)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN p1.elev > p2.elev THEN 'Rockland Psychiatric Center, Orangeburg, NY'
    WHEN p2.elev > p1.elev THEN 'The University of Tennessee Health Science Center, Memphis, TN'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS higher_poi,
  p1.elev AS poi1_elevation_m,
  p2.elev AS poi2_elevation_m
FROM p1, p2;

WITH locations AS (
  SELECT 
    '[3]' AS id,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-73.967704, 41.049287), 4326)::geography AS geom
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    '[4]' AS id,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-90.031353, 35.139317), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
elevations AS (
  SELECT 
    l.id,
    ST_Value(
      r.rast,
      ST_Transform(l.geom::geometry, 4326)
    ) AS elevation
  FROM locations l
  JOIN public.dem_us r
    ON ST_Intersects(
      r.rast,
      ST_Transform(l.geom::geometry, 4326)
    )
)
SELECT 
  CASE
    WHEN e1.elevation > e2.elevation THEN e1.id
    WHEN e2.elevation > e1.elevation THEN e2.id
    ELSE 'Equal'
  END AS more_elevated,
  e1.elevation AS rockland_elevation,
  e2.elevation AS ut_hsc_elevation
FROM elevations e1
JOIN elevations e2
  ON e1.id = '[3]' AND e2.id = '[4]';
